tier1.text: Each semispinalis thoracis extends, or bends back, the spine. This muscle also turns the spine toward the contralateral, or opposite, side. The semispinalis thoracis is a muscle of the thoracic region, the upper back. This muscle attaches to spinous processes, the bumps you can feel down the middle of the back.

quotes.quote: One of the transversospinales group of muscles that arises from C6-C7 cervical and T1-T4 spinous processes, and inserts into the transverse processes of the T6-T10 vertebrae; it functions to extend the spine and rotate it toward the contralateral side.
